newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Charlotte County, Fla..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Charlotte County, Fla..

text.p: School District of Charlotte County, Florida

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed bids for the purchase of all, but not less than all, of $8,000,000* aggregate principal amount of Tax Anticipation Notes, Series 1996 (the Notes'') of the School District of Charlotte County, Florida (the District'' ceived by the School

Board of Charlotte County, Florida (the Board'') acting as the governing body of the District and publicly opened by the Finance Director or the Financial Advisor to the Board at the place and up to the time below specified. Time: 11:00 A.M. Tuesday, October 8, 1996
Bids may be mailed, couriered, telecopied or hand

The Notes will be dated the date of issuance of the Notes (presently anticipated to be October 17, 1996), will be issued in fully registered book-entry-only form through a system of registration maintained by The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York as securities depository, will be sold in beneficial interests of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof and will pay interest only upon their maturity on June 30, 1997. At the time of delivery of the Notes, the District will also deliver to the successful bidder, at the expense of the District, the approving opinion of Nabors, Giblin &
Nickerson, P.A., Tampa, Florida, Bond Counsel, in
substantially the form appearing in the Preliminary Official Statement described below. The complete Official Notice of Sale, Official Bid Form, along with the Preliminary Official Statement dated

September 30, 1996 (the Preliminary Official Statement'') may be obtained from Gregory Griner, Finance Director, at the School District of Charlotte County, Murdock Center, 1445 Education Way, Port Charlotte, Florida 33948-1053, Phone No. (941) 255-0808, Ext. 3132, or from Kevin Conitz, William R. Hough & Co., 100 Second Avenue South, Suite 800, St. Petersburg, Florida 33701-4386 Phone No. (813) 895-8880, Financial Advisor to the Board. The Preliminary Official Statement as of its date is to be deemed final by the District for purposes of SEC Rule 15c2-12(b)(1), but is subject to revision, amendment and completion in a final Official Statement.
The School District of Charlotte County, Florida
